steps.title: Start at the Dashboard
steps.narration: Every session starts here on the Dashboard — let's head over to the Watchlist to see what's new this time.
steps.point_out: The familiar left sidebar, with Watchlist among the items.

steps.title: Open the Watchlist
steps.narration: The Watchlist page hasn't moved — same saved-stocks table as always — but scrolling down now reveals something brand new underneath it.
steps.point_out: The existing entries table for ABBV and MSFT, and below it a new "Concentration X-ray" card headlined "≈ 2.0 effective independent bets".

steps.title: See how correlated the two names really are
steps.narration: A real, computed correlation shows exactly how ABBV and MSFT move relative to each other — a number, not just a guess or a color with nothing behind it.
steps.point_out: The ABBV × MSFT cell reading "-0.11" in red, right where the two rows and columns cross.

steps.title: See the cluster grouping
steps.narration: Because ABBV and MSFT aren't correlated enough to move together, the X-ray keeps them as two separate clusters instead of merging them into one.
steps.point_out: Two separate gray badges — "ABBV" and "MSFT" — under the Clusters heading, not one joined badge.

expect.text: Names grouped when their correlation is at or above 0.70.

steps.title: See where the watchlist is concentrated
steps.narration: Three bar breakdowns show sector, theme, and shared-setup concentration for the whole list — including an honest "Unassigned" bucket for any stock without a mapped sector, never a blank or crashed row.
steps.point_out: The "Technology" and "Unassigned" sector bars, three theme bars, and a single red "Avoid" setup bar that reuses the exact same red used in the table above.

steps.title: Check the methodology behind the headline
steps.narration: Clicking the small info icon next to "effective independent bets" opens a plain-language explanation of exactly how that number is worked out.
steps.point_out: The tooltip spelling out both the 126-trading-day window and the 60-day minimum-history requirement, in plain language.

expect.text: eigenvalues of the pairwise correlation matrix

steps.title: Add a new name
steps.narration: Typing a new ticker into the existing Add form sets up a live test of the X-ray — the next step shows the whole grid grow to include it.
steps.point_out: "AAPL" typed into the Ticker field, ready to add.

steps.title: Watch the X-ray update live
steps.narration: Adding AAPL grows the correlation grid from 2×2 to 3×3 automatically — every figure recalculates from the real saved list, nothing is hand-entered.
steps.point_out: The new AAPL row in the entries table, and the correlation grid now covering three names instead of two.

steps.title: Remove the demo name and confirm the list is restored
steps.narration: Removing AAPL again shrinks the grid straight back to the original ABBV/MSFT view, confirming the new section never disturbs the existing watchlist.
steps.point_out: The entries table back to two rows, and the X-ray matching its original figures.
